additions.name: Applied Digital Jamestown — 106 MW data-center hosting facility, existing operations (APLD Hosting LLC)

status.summary: Applied Digital's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 31 August 2026, filed on 7 October 2026, reports that its 106 MW data-center hosting facility in Jamestown, North Dakota continued to operate at full capacity as of 31 August 2026, providing energized space to crypto-mining customers; the same filing refers to the energy services agreement for the Jamestown co-hosting facility. This records operation of the hosting facility as of the period end. It does not establish the IT load actually drawn, the separate APLD GPU-01 building on Auditor's Lot 17-2C (no capacity is stated for it in the captured filings), or any conversion to AI workloads; 106 MW is the company's stated facility size.

locator.precision: Centroid of the union of the three Stutsman County tax parcels forming Auditor's Lot 17-2 in the SE1/4 of Section 17, T141N R63W (parcels 181741040 and 181744040 of APLD Hosting LLC at 2671 and 2683 Hwy 20 SE, and 181741044 of APLD GPU-01 LLC), 40.0 geodesic acres about 280 by 809 m, from the ND GIS Hub statewide parcel layer. It locates the APLD Jamestown property as a whole, not a hosting building, the GPU-01 building or the electrical interconnection.
locator.identity_review: The ND GIS Hub tax roll (2025 roll, imported 1 October 2026) lists APLD HOSTING LLC as owner of parcels 181741040 (2671 Hwy 20 SE, Jamestown; Auditor's Lot 17-2A, commercial, one structure) and 181744040 (2683 Hwy 20 SE, Jamestown; Lot 17-2B, one structure), and APLD GPU-01 LLC as owner of 181741044 (Lot 17-2C, commercial, one structure); a statewide owner search finds no other APLD Hosting or GPU-01 parcel. Applied Digital's FY2026 Form 10-K identifies APLD Hosting, LLC as the wholly owned subsidiary whose loan is secured by the master hosting and electric services agreements related to the Jamestown hosting facility, and says APLD GPU-01, LLC's AI cloud services are serviced at the Jamestown hosting facility; the 10-K and 10-Q describe that facility as 106 MW in Jamestown, North Dakota. The Stutsman County parcel layer returns the same three PIDs, legal descriptions and polygons (centroid difference 0.0 m). The Jamestown city centre, the county centre and the nearby Jamestown Regional Airport are not used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: ND GIS Hub and Stutsman County publish no positional accuracy for parcel polygons; the centroid represents a 40-acre property about 0.28 by 0.81 km whose individual buildings are not separately located.

additions.distinctness_review: Screened on 26 October 2026 against every row of sites.csv, projects.csv and evidence.csv of verified_construction_core/2026-10-26-research-sixtysixth (675 sites, 717 projects, 3,667 evidence rows), its source-records.json and identity-mapping.json, every pending queue fragment's changes.json and holds.json, claims.tsv and all sources/*-holds.json, for Jamestown, Stutsman, APLD Hosting, APLD GPU-01, Hwy 20 SE, the three parcel numbers and Applied Digital hosting. No record names this facility, and no Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping location or queued point lies within 50 km (none within 2 km). The Atlas's other Applied Digital records are Polaris Forge 1 (Ellendale, about 112 km south), Polaris Forge 2 (Harwood), Polaris Forge 3 (Center), Delta Forge 1 (Alexandria, Louisiana) and Delta Forge 2 (Alabama), all different properties. The only queue entry for this facility is this fragment's own claim.
additions.successor_review: The 10-Q filed on 7 October 2026 is Applied Digital's latest periodic report. Its investor press-release index (captured 26 October 2026) lists the 7 October fiscal first-quarter results as the newest release, and its SEC filing index lists only Forms 4 and a Schedule 13G after the 10-Q (13 to 19 October). No sale, shutdown, conversion or curtailment of the Jamestown facility was found; the 10-K notes that the hosting contract with the single crypto-mining customer has about one and a half years remaining, which is a future contract term, not a status change.

additions.name: Applied Digital Ellendale 180 MW data-center hosting facility — existing operations
additions.site_identity_review: The ND GIS Hub tax roll places all four outlots of the SE1/4 of Section 4, T129N R63W (Ellendale Township, Dickey County) in Applied Digital ELN entities: Outlot 4-1 (40 acres, 9685 87th Ave SE) owned by APLD ELN-01, LLC; Outlot 4-4 (24.78 acres, 9663 87th Ave SE) owned by APLD ELN-02 A LLC; Outlot 4-2 owned by APLD ELN-02, LLC; and Outlot 4-3 owned by APLD ELN-02 Holdings, LLC. 9663 87th Ave SE is the address of the CoreWeave building leases and of the NDDEQ ELN Building 1 generator plant whose coordinate is this site's campus locator, and the statewide parcel polygons of that quarter section form one 160-acre block containing the locator 55 m from its centre. Applied Digital's 10-K names ELN-02, ELN-03 and ELN-02 C as the Polaris Forge 1 HPC landlords and APLD ELN-01 LLC as the borrower of the Starion Ellendale Loan, and its 10-K and 10-Q describe a separate 180 MW crypto-mining hosting facility in Ellendale; the hosting facility is therefore taken to be the ELN-01 property on Outlot 4-1 (an inference from these records, not a single statement). The site's existing projects already treat the operating crypto hosting as part of this Ellendale campus and exclude it from their scopes, so it is a further project on the same campus, not a new site.

status.summary: Applied Digital's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 31 August 2026, filed on 7 October 2026, reports that its 180 MW data-center hosting facility in Ellendale, North Dakota continued to operate at full capacity as of 31 August 2026, providing energized space to crypto-mining customers. It does not concern the Polaris Forge 1 HPC buildings (separate projects on this site), does not establish the IT load actually drawn, and does not imply any conversion of the hosting facility to AI workloads; 180 MW is the company's stated facility size.

locator.identity_review: Reuses the existing Polaris Forge 1 Campus point exactly: the NDDEQ permit coordinate of the ELN Building 1 backup-generator plant at 9663 87th Ave SE (Outlot 4-4), with its pinned geometry and geometry-identity evidence. The hosting facility's Outlot 4-1 (9685 87th Ave SE) lies in the same APLD-owned SE1/4 of Section 4, T129N R63W, whose farthest corner is about 0.63 km from the point. The point locates the campus through that constituent plant, not the hosting buildings.

The 10-K's statement that the single hosting contract has about one and a half years remaining is a contract term, not a status change.
